name: watch
description: Analyze video URLs and local files with timestamped captions, optional Whisper transcription, and representative frames.

interface.shortDescription: Analyze a video URL or path with grounded speech and visual evidence.
interface.longDescription: Watch downloads a video with yt-dlp, extracts representative frames with ffmpeg, obtains a timestamped transcript from captions or an optional Whisper provider, and gives the active model evidence grounded in both the audio and visuals. Breadboard uses its guarded ChatMock-compatible runtime; other skill hosts use the bundled scripts.
defaultPrompt: /watch https://youtu.be/dQw4w9WgXcQ what happens at the 30 second mark?
